cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women, with 50 having PIH without HELLP syndrome and 50 having PIH with HELLP syndrome.
finding: HELLP syndrome significantly worsens maternal complications (e.g., higher systolic blood pressure, lower hemoglobin, increased acute kidney injury, DIC, blood transfusion needs) and neonatal complications (e.g., earlier gestational age at delivery, higher rates of respiratory distress, intrauterine fetal death, intraventricular hemorrhage) in patients with PIH.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were markedly higher in women with HELLP syndrome (92% vs. 66%, P < 0.00001).
gest_age: Women with HELLP syndrome delivered at a significantly earlier gestational age (32 weeks vs. 36.6 weeks).
